payload.rationale: Retain center80F and SD3F: current evidence confirms plausibility and eligibility but supplies no calibrated reason to change either number. Do not shrink uncertainty solely because two correlated NWS products agree.
payload.findings: NWS observed62.1F at06:51EDT; overnight readings shown are61–64F. The07:02EDT discussion leaves the forecast broadly unchanged, with dry ridging and a possible southerly wind shift.
limitations: Text-only point-forecast and api.weather.gov opens failed in web retrieval. TWC page also inaccessible. Exact TWC daily rounding remains unverified. NWS hourly records do not fully substitute for the final TWC extreme.
